  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice hpq =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨s2', ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceL ht2, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR ht, HomBisimilarity.refl _⟩
    · intro s2' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨s1', ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceL ht1, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR ht, HomBisimilarity.refl _⟩
  | bisim hpq =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' ht
      obtain ⟨s2', ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨s2', ht2, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
    · intro s2' ht
      obtain ⟨s1', ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨s1', ht1, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ChoiceBisim.choice h
  have symm : ∀ {a b}, ChoiceBisim a b → ChoiceBisim b a := by
    intro a b hab
    cases hab with
    | choice hpq => exact ChoiceBisim.choice hpq.symm
    | bisim hpq => exact ChoiceBisim.bisim hpq.symm
  have follow : ∀ {a b}, ChoiceBisim a b → ∀ μ a', Tr a μ a' → ∃ b', Tr b μ b' ∧ ChoiceBisim a' b' := by
    intro a b hab μ a' ht
    cases hab with
    | choice hpq =>
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨b', ht', hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨b', Tr.choiceL ht', ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨a', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | bisim hpq =>
      obtain ⟨b', ht', hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨b', ht', ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
  intro a b hab μ
  exact ⟨follow hab μ, fun c ht => by
    obtain ⟨a', ht', hab'⟩ := follow (symm hab) μ ht
    exact ⟨a', ht', symm hab'⟩⟩

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice hpq =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨_, ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceL ht2, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · intro s2' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨_, ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceL ht1, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim hpq =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' ht
      obtain ⟨_, ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨_, ht2, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
    · intro s2' ht
      obtain ⟨_, ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨_, ht1, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice hpq =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' ht
      cases ht with

        obtain ⟨s2', ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceL ht2, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (.refl _)⟩
    · intro s2' ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨s1', ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceL ht1, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (.refl _)⟩
  | bisim hpq =>
    constructor
    · intro s1' ht
      obtain ⟨s2', ht2, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨s2', ht2, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
    · intro s2' ht
      obtain ⟨s1', ht1, hb⟩ := hpq.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨s1', ht1, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
